_about: Player journal & map annotations (List 20 #191). The two-layer rule made mechanical: the record's schema contains no field that could name a world fact, so the player layer cannot write the canon world. The fragment instances no annotation.

annotation.body: player-authored text — the player's own words (#106's box-label rule), not system vocabulary
annotation.phase: #19 phase at writing: dawn | day | dusk | night

journalEntry.editedBeat: edits update this, never the original timestamp

rendering.atlasOverlay: pins render on the player's own #137 atlas view only; the canon rendering is identical with the layer on or off; a pin on an undiscovered target renders only when its target renders
rendering.systemStrings: Leak rule binds all system text around pins (#137/#85); player body text is content, not system vocabulary

seat: proposed `journal` section in #96's save payload map — player-authored, checksummed, owned by no world system (lands only in #96's home)

share.channel: #90-format block via a proposed `journal_share` generator (lands only in #90's home)
share.rule: a shared journal is a read-only artefact — never merged into a recipient's layer, never pinned to their atlas, imports no facts

twoLayerRule: annotations REFERENCE canon ids; they cannot express flags, states, quantities, or discovery — no write path exists by construction
